title: Female borrowers who use strong descriptors for their own effort and determination may fund faster.
Female borrowers who mention external business challenges like unpredictable weather or rising costs may fund faster.
Female borrowers who express explicit gratitude to lenders may fund faster.
Female borrowers who provide detailed lists of specific supplies or inventory items may fund more slowly.
Female borrowers who mention their specific age may fund more slowly.
Female borrowers who include the loan amount in local currency may fund faster.
Female borrowers who list specific inventory items like soap or shampoo may fund faster.
Female borrowers who focus on asset acquisition as their primary loan goal may fund more slowly.
Female borrowers who use the phrase 'hardworking entrepreneur' may fund more slowly.
Female borrowers who mention sourcing products directly from Kampala may fund faster.
Female borrowers who mention the goal of building savings fund faster.
Higher verbosity and excessive personal detail predict slower funding regardless of gender.
Pitches that include specific monthly income figures predict slower funding regardless of gender.
Female borrowers who emphasize that their business is currently doing well or is being sustained fund faster.
Mentioning specific asset or business ownership predicts faster funding regardless of gender.
Borrowers who explicitly name their institutional partner fund faster regardless of gender.
Mentioning family responsibilities or supporting family members predicts slower funding regardless of gender.
Female borrowers who use aspirational language such as 'dreams' for their business fund faster.
